# glinet_wifi_status (Data Source)

Get the state of the Wi-Fi radios (`wifi.get_status`). The values change while the router runs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glinet_wifi_status" "wifi" {}

output "radio_channels" {
  value = { for r in data.glinet_wifi_status.wifi.radios : r.name => r.channel }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `radios` (Attributes List) Wi-Fi radios (`res`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--radios))

<a id="nestedatt--radios"></a>
### Nested Schema for `radios`

Read-Only:

- `channel` (Number) Channel of the radio. Null when the router gives none.
- `name` (String) Name of the radio, for example `radio0`.
- `state` (String) State of the radio, for example `ready`.
